sources.title: Micron — Q4 FY2026 earnings call announcement

events.title: Producer Price Index
events.summary: BLS scheduled the August producer-price release for September 10 at 8:30 a.m. Eastern.
events.watchFor: Read the final-demand release and revisions alongside consumer inflation.
events.limitation: The scheduled time has passed. This calendar does not confirm publication or supply the actual values.

events.title: Adobe earnings call
events.summary: Adobe lists its Q3 FY2026 earnings call for September 10 at 2 p.m. Pacific.
events.watchFor: Compare revenue, guidance and management commentary with the company’s prior disclosures.
events.limitation: This is the conference-call time. The results may be published earlier; no release-time price or options quote is supplied.

events.title: Consumer Price Index
events.summary: BLS schedules the August consumer-price release for September 11 at 8:30 a.m. Eastern.
events.watchFor: Check headline and core inflation, seasonal adjustment and any revisions in the official release.
events.limitation: Consensus estimates, actual release values and a validated market-reaction model are not connected.

events.title: FOMC policy decision
events.summary: The Federal Reserve calendar lists the September 15–16 meeting at 2 p.m. on September 16.
events.watchFor: Read the policy statement and compare the wording with the preceding meeting.
events.limitation: The meeting schedule does not establish the outcome or the direction of stock prices.

events.title: FOMC press conference
events.summary: The Federal Reserve lists its September 16 FOMC press conference for 2:30 p.m.
events.watchFor: Watch for clarification of the statement and the outlook during questions.
events.limitation: An explanation during the press conference can differ from the first market reaction; no reaction forecast is published.

events.title: U.S. import and export prices
events.summary: BLS schedules August import and export price indexes for September 16 at 8:30 a.m. Eastern.
events.watchFor: Check import and export price changes and the contribution from energy.
events.limitation: This is a selected release calendar; no reported values or consensus estimates are included.

events.title: Job openings and labor turnover
events.summary: BLS schedules the August JOLTS release for September 29 at 10 a.m. Eastern.
events.watchFor: Read openings, hires, quits and revisions together rather than one headline.
events.limitation: No actual release, survey-consensus series or calibrated asset response is available in this artifact.

events.title: Micron earnings call
events.summary: Micron announced a Q4 earnings call on September 30 at 2:30 p.m. Mountain time.
events.watchFor: Compare reported results and guidance with Micron’s prior company guidance.
events.limitation: The call time is verified. The exact results-release time is not, so it cannot anchor an implied-versus-realized move calculation.

limitations: These initial records were verified against official public pages on September 10, 2026. Manual verification is not an automatic data connection.
Manual-source content hashes cover the retained structured calendar observations, not a downloaded copy of the entire source page.
Calendar dates can change. Source verification times and review deadlines remain visible when an export or failed refresh occurs.
This release has no calibrated probabilities, forecast performance, consensus feed, options quotes or trading authority.
An earnings conference-call time is not the timestamp when the results first became public.
The evidence journal starts empty. Qualitative watch checklists are not registered predictions or observed outcomes.
